services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Host your next event at the Chicago Cultural Center. The stunning landmark offers a variety of options for large and small gatherings - from weddings, galas and cocktail receptions to corporate events, conferences and meetings. The historic building is home to two magnificent stained-glass domes and many unique event spaces including galleries, halls and a theater. The Chicago Cultural Center is a People’s Palace, and rental fees help to support its free public programming. The Department of Cultural Affairs and Special Events (DCASE) welcomes requests for use of the Chicago Cultural Center. blurb: Drawn by its beauty and the fabulous free public events, hundreds of thousands of visitors come to the Chicago Cultural Center every year, making it one of the most visited attractions in Chicago. The stunning landmark building is home to two magnificent stained-glass domes, as well as free music, dance and theater events, films, lectures, art exhibitions and family events.
